source: can you please make a game where u dress up and you have a opportunity for skinny, muscle and fat body tips with opportunity of clothes and you can walk around and explore and interact

answers.ask: Should this be a modern shopping-mall look, a bright cartoon boutique, or a fashion-studio interior?
answers.answer: Use a bright cartoon boutique look, with clear clothing and body-shape options that are easy to explore.

answers.ask: Is there a runway or judging element, or is it purely free-roam dress-up?
answers.answer: Make it purely free-roam dress-up: players can change their body type and clothes, then walk around, explore, and interact.

blob:
## Clarifications resolved
- [author] theme — Q: Should this be a modern shopping-mall look, a bright cartoon boutique, or a fashion-studio interior? A: Use a bright cartoon boutique look, with clear clothing and body-shape options that are easy to explore.
- [author] shape — Q: Is there a runway or judging element, or is it purely free-roam dress-up? A: Make it purely free-roam dress-up: players can change their body type and clothes, then walk around, explore, and interact.

## Enriched image prompt
Create one bright cartoon boutique interior for free-roam dress-up, with clear walkable circulation between clothing displays and interactive changing areas. Arrange three easy-to-distinguish body-shape selection stations for skinny, muscular, and fat body options, plus clothing racks and displays offering outfits. Keep the boutique open enough for players to walk around, explore, and interact without a runway, judging area, or separated exterior space.

## Genre
The dominant genre is Roleplay & Avatar Sim. The activity is avatar customization and free-roam social interaction, specifically the genre’s dress-up family without competitive judging.

## Shape and preset
Use `interior-single`: one enclosed boutique is the entire map, so players never cross an exterior boundary. Preset is none because the Dress Up preset’s defining `stage-runway` shape and judging presentation directly conflict with the author’s purely free-roam answer.

## Config requirements
No canonical image-config option is needed. The boutique’s clothing racks, outfit displays, mirrors or changing displays, and three body-shape stations are prompt-specific visible geometry and should be rendered directly without adding a runway, scenic photo set, town, or social hub the author did not request.

## Layout requirements
Add three free-text `TriggerZone` placements, one at each body-shape station, for the skinny, muscular, and fat choices. Add free-text `TriggerZone` placements at the clothing racks or outfit displays; their count remains unspecified and should follow the visible display layout. Site every interaction point with clear standing room and keep it out of the main circulation path.

## Layout components
Build one bounded boutique room with an open central browsing floor. Place the three body-shape stations together in a clearly labelled customization area and distribute clothing racks and outfit displays around the remaining floor and walls. Connect all displays with simple walkable aisles and leave room to stop and interact. The enclosing boutique walls form the boundary, and the composition should show the whole interior and its customization zones at once.

## Render order
Use `isometric`: the bright boutique presentation and readable display arrangement lead, while the single-room circulation has no topology that requires a plan-first route.

## Scale, theme, and pipeline cost
Use small scale because individual racks, outfits, and interaction stations must remain legible within one room. The theme is a bright, approachable cartoon boutique. Use `P0`: this is one interior-only surface with no outside-to-inside transition, overhanging level, separate map, or generated-validity requirement.
